output.reframed_request: «Нужно продать цифровые пианино до Нового года» → Sell more in-stock digital pianos (units over the normal run-rate) between 2026-10-13 and 2026-12-31. To do that, turn the December gift season into coded WhatsApp chats about specific models. The content should resolve the doubts that stall a 200k–2M ₸ purchase: which model, warranty, delivery and returns.
output.business_objective: Sell +10 digital pianos (working default; conservative +5 / stretch +20) above the normal run-rate, across all in-stock digital piano models. Weight the push toward high-stock SKUs: Estrada EDP-220BK (9 units on site), Casio PX-S1100BKC7 (5), Casio AP-270 BKC7 (5) and Casio AP-300WEC7 (4). Window: 2026-10-13 to 2026-12-31. output.marketing_objective: Two audiences: (1) parents in Astana, and across Kazakhstan via delivery, who plan a New Year gift for a child who is learning or starting piano; (2) adults restarting piano at home. They send the store a coded WhatsApp message asking for help choosing an in-stock digital piano, or to see or reserve a specific model. Deadline 2026-12-31; the conversion push runs 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31.

OWNER: ≤15 min onboarding, ≤5 min/week, one batched message. No direct contact yet; all asks and approvals go through Andrey (MetaPrompt) and Pavel, which adds latency (stated)
STAFF: ≤17 planned min/week (20 incl. safety), one mid/low-quality phone; audio usable only with the phone close to the instrument (stated)

FILMING: hands, keys, instruments and voice only; no faces until consent is asked (stated: consent unknown → default). Customers only with consent on camera; children (likely buyers' kids) only with a parent's written OK

STOCK: site stock flags/qty are usable for ≤48 h. Feature only SKUs shown in stock on the day of publishing. No «осталось N» / «последние» even though site qty is visible, unless the owner confirms the count (evidence: 11 of 25 sampled piano listings are out of stock)

OFFER: no new offers. These published terms may be cited exactly: sale-page old/new prices (e.g. Gewa UP365, Kurzweil M100SR, Gewa UP400, re-fetched); free delivery across KZ over 100 000 ₸ (delivery_free_100k); 14-day return of goods of proper quality with the stated conditions, with two-way delivery cost withheld (returns_14d, returns_conditions, returns_cost); minimum 12-month warranty (warranty); Casio 2-year manufacturer warranty with service only in Almaty (warranty_casio); payment methods (payments). NO installment/рассрочка claim; not in ledger (evidence)

CAPACITY: stock-limited, not labour-limited. Site sample 2026-10-08/09 shows 16 in-stock digital piano SKUs ≈ 42 units, many single-unit. December delivery and assembly capacity is unknown, so no «доставим до Нового года» / «завтра» claims (default)
REGULATED: not a regulated category. When content involves children, no outcome claims («ребёнок станет музыкантом») (default)

AVOID: politics, religion, ethnicity, mocking customers, naming competitors (default). Also do NOT repeat the site claim «100% оригинальный товар» (absolute, no third-party source), do NOT use «Финальная распродажа» as urgency until reason and end date are confirmed, and do NOT promote the 'delivery compensation for an honest review/video' clause (incentivised reviews; platform-rule risk) (evidence)

ACCOUNTS: YouTube exists (3 620 subs, 379 videos, median 2 300 views, last upload 2026-05-10); Instagram muzzone_astana exists (not analysed: blocks anonymous fetch); VK and Facebook exist; TikTok unknown, so this is an owner ask. Business accounts use commercial-library music only (evidence)
LANGUAGE: RU audience copy; KZ captions only after a native check (default)
APPROVAL: owner approves each weekly batch explicitly via Andrey/Pavel; offers, faces and spend always need explicit approval (default)
GUARDRAIL: median first WhatsApp reply ≤15 min during working hours (site lists calls Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–17:00) (default)
GUARDRAIL: never feature an out-of-stock piano. The CTA routes only to models in stock on the day of publishing (default)
GUARDRAIL: returns of campaign-sold pianos not above the owner's normal rate. Returns cost the buyer two-way delivery, so the expectations shown in content must be accurate (default)
assumptions: [ASSUMPTION] «до Нового года» = by 2026-12-31; measurement window 2026-10-13 → 2026-12-31 (~11.5 weeks; week 0 = 2026-10-09..12) | if wrong: re-plan backwards from the real date | verify: Q1 answer by 2026-10-10 12:00

SECONDARY: the site-wide «Финальная распродажа» (cymbals, drum kits, amps) may mean store closure, a brand exit or a stock clearance. It gets ≤20% of slots, or waits for the next sprint. If the owner says the store or this line is closing, the primary objective becomes liquidating all stock and the plan is rebuilt

LADDER: «продать пианино» → чтобы что? → cash and inventory turned before year-end → units of digital pianos sold by 2026-12-31 (the first number the business counts). Forks recorded and not chosen: (a) only the high-ticket single units (Gewa UP400 1 380 908 ₸, Dexibell VIVO H10 2 075 617 ₸), which are large value but have tiny volume and slow learning; (b) piano revenue in ₸ rather than units, which needs margin data we do not have. Chosen branch: units across all in-stock models, weighted to high-stock SKUs (Estrada EDP-220BK 9, Casio PX-S1100BKC7 5, AP-270 5, AP-300WE 4), because that is where free 'capacity' (stock) is and it is measurable

BOTTLENECK: consideration, low-to-medium confidence. Evidence: a high-ticket considered purchase (in-stock range 200 720 ₸ – 2 075 617 ₸); choice confusion across ~25 listed models and 6+ brands; real doubts in the ledger (Casio service only in Almaty, warranty_casio; return withholds two-way delivery, returns_cost); brand-only demos underperform on this channel (L006: 390 vs 2 300 median). Conversion is a possible co-bottleneck (WhatsApp reply time and close rate unknown; no chat export yet). Verify with the WhatsApp export in step 2

clarifying_questions: Почему продать пианино нужно именно до Нового года и что означает «Финальная распродажа» на сайте? 1 — просто сезон подарков, 2 — магазин закрывается или уходит из направления, 3 — освобождаем склад под новую поставку. По умолчанию: 1, и в роликах никаких сроков и слов «последние». Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Сколько цифровых пианино вы обычно продаёте в месяц (примерно) и сколько хотите продать с 13.10 по 31.12? По умолчанию: обычный темп считаем по остаткам на сайте за 2 недели, цель — +10 штук сверх него. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.

Какие пианино продвигать в первую очередь? 1 — тех, которых больше всего на складе по сайту (Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100, Casio AP-270, Casio AP-300 белое), 2 — с лучшей маржой (назовите 2–3 модели), 3 — все в наличии поровну. По умолчанию: 1. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.
output.push_back: Пианино за 200 тыс. – 2 млн ₸ покупают обдуманно, поэтому ролики сначала снимают сомнения (какое выбрать, гарантия, доставка, возврат), и заметных продаж от них раньше чем через 3–4 недели ждать не стоит. Органикой реально +5–10 пианино сверх обычного; больше — только с рассылкой по прошлым покупателям и продвижением лучших роликов, это решим к концу ноября по фактическим цифрам. Слово «Финальная» и сроки в роликах не используем, пока вы не подтвердите причину и дату, а цену Casio PX-770 не показываем: на сайте она за сутки сменилась с 695 913 ₸ на 521 935 ₸. И ещё: компенсация доставки за отзыв (условие на странице возврата) может нарушать правила площадок — советуем её убрать.

insights.insight: [tension] When a parent plans a New Year piano for a child who studies or is starting music, they want 'the right one, enough for school, without overpaying'. But they face 133 listings, in-stock prices from 200 720 ₸ to 2 075 617 ₸, and spec sheets that look identical to a non-pianist (88 keys everywhere; 128 vs 192 polyphony). Many listed models are out of stock. So they look up model names one by one (plain model-name piano demos are our best piano videos, median 3 100, KA130 11 000), ask someone they trust, or postpone. We can show, with hands and close sound in the shop, the same short phrase on the 3 high-stock models across three real price points (Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100, Casio AP-270), plus what actually differs. This moves coded WhatsApp chats about in-stock SKUs because the natural next step is «напишите код — подберём из того, что есть в наличии». JUDGMENT: the fear is inferred, not quoted (E34). Re-rank after the chat export.
insights.tension: Wants a correct, school-worthy gift without overpaying vs cannot tell 200k from 750k pianos apart and fears choosing wrong or buying a model that is gone
insights.who_feels_it: A non-musician parent or relative in Astana (or a region, via delivery) choosing a first or upgrade digital piano as a gift for a child in or entering music lessons
insights.content_reality: Pianos in stock at the shop (provisional location «зал с пианино», pending the reality scan; E29 shows in-store playing was filmed before). Hands play the same 8-second phrase on EDP-220BK, PX-S1100 and AP-270, phone at 20–30 cm from the speaker. Prices only from ledger ids, re-fetched ≤7 days. EDP-220BK and PX-S1100 prices need ledger entries first.

insights.insight: [friction] When a buyer outside the shop, especially in a region, considers a 230k–750k ₸ piano, they want to be sure before paying. But the only safety net they see costs them: a return within 14 days withholds two-way delivery (+3% COD), and the shop shows almost no reviews (1 review across 12 sampled product pages). So they hesitate, ask for more photos, or buy where they can touch it. We can show the real 'try before you pay' path: how to check a piano in the shop (keys, pedals, sound at the volume you'll use at home). As a non-price offer pending owner approval, we can also offer a video of the exact unit before dispatch. This moves coded chats because it turns the remote buyer's risk into one WhatsApp message.
insights.tension: Wants certainty before a large remote purchase vs a return that costs real money and no visible social proof
insights.who_feels_it: A buyer who cannot easily come to Кажымукана 14 (other districts, other cities) and is weighing ordering a piano for delivery
insights.content_reality: Hands checking a piano at «зал с пианино»: pressing each pedal, a slow key run at 20–30 cm, volume knob. On-screen policy text only from returns_14d / returns_conditions / returns_cost / delivery_free_100k. The 'video of your unit' offer is NOT shown until the owner says «да». insights.insight: [moment] When New Year approaches, a parent wants the piano at home and set up by 31 December, often as a surprise. But a piano is a big box, delivery lead times and December capacity are unknown, the pickup reservation lasts only 3 working days (extendable on request), and half the in-stock models are single units. So they leave the decision to late December and risk the model being gone or the delivery arriving late. We can show the real timeline and the reservation option as practical planning, with no countdowns and no «последние». Choose in October or November, ask to hold, collect when it suits. This moves December conversions earlier, while stock still exists, without inventing urgency. The calendar demand peak itself is an assumption (E37), and our only past New Year video was a greeting-style novelty that flopped (233 views), so moment content must be practical, not festive.
insights.tension: Wants it ready under the tree on the 31st vs delivery and stock uncertainty plus no clear way to buy early and hide it
insights.who_feels_it: A family in Astana planning a New Year surprise for a child who has nowhere to hide a piano box and is not sure when to buy

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] When someone buys a digital piano as a gift, they want the child to sit down and play on day one. But the spec sheets of the models we checked say there is no bench included («Банкетка: Нет»), and there is no Bluetooth. So buyers discover on unboxing what is missing (a seat at the right height, possibly headphones or a stand, depending on the model) and make a second trip or improvise. We can show, hands only, what is actually in the box of an in-stock model and what else a beginner needs, using only accessories and facts we can source. This moves coded chats («напишите код — соберём полный комплект под вашу модель») and builds trust that the shop thinks ahead for the buyer.

insights.insight: [friction] When an Astana buyer spends 360k–755k ₸ on a Casio, they want it to just work for years. The store states a minimum 12-month warranty and Casio has a 2-year manufacturer warranty, but Casio service is only in Almaty. So a careful buyer wonders «а если сломается — везти пианино в Алматы?» and may hesitate on Casio, which accounts for 3 of the 4 highest-stock SKUs. We can tell the policy honestly as a story: what happens step by step if a key fails, who ships it, and who pays. This only works once the owner confirms the real process. An honest_signal piece ('here is the one downside, and here is how we handle it') moves trust and chats on the Casio line. JUDGMENT: the buyer worry is inferred (E34); the facts are verified.

insights.insight: [proof] When piano buyers research, they look up the exact model, not a lesson or a show. On our channel, plain model-name piano demos (median 3 100; KA130 11 000, 4.8×) beat in-store kids' performances (median 746) and adult improvisation lessons (median ≈317). The single piano head-to-head reached only 1 100, and adult lessons are why we drop an 'adult restarter' insight for now. These buyers want to hear this specific model before paying 230k–755k ₸, but most of our in-stock models have no demo, and the channel has been dormant since May. We can publish 'how this exact in-stock model sounds' at 20–30 cm in under 20 seconds, cross-posted with plain model-name titles for search. This moves consideration into chats naming a SKU. Caveat: this evidence is long-form and correlational, and Shorts may behave differently (E27, L003).

insights.insight: [content_reality] Outsiders never hear a 200k, 750k and 2M ₸ piano play the same notes side by side, close up, or hear the mechanical sound of the keys themselves.
